Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: The Bible speaks about wicked women and how hard they made it for the nation of Israel. Elisha the prophet sent one of the children of the prophets to Ramoth-gilead to find Jehu, anoint him king over Israel, and then flee. He told him, God sent me to make you the new king, because the original king was wicked: thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets at the hand of Jezebel.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jezebel, a strong independent woman, was attacking God's prophets, so God wanted judgment on her for not listening to what he said. He said, I'm going to put a king in place who could address you with the right answer from God. And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehu's men asked, wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? When he told them what happened, they hasted, put their garments under him on the top of the stairs, blew with trumpets, and said, Jehu is king.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Joram, the son of Ahab and Jezebel, rode out to meet Jehu and asked, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many? There's no peace as long as you got a wicked woman in power. And that's what America likes to do: set up wicked women and empower women that go against God.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Joram turned his hands and fled, saying, There is treachery, O Ahaziah. And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: When Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it, and she painted her face and tired her head and looked out at a window. Armies coming into the city, and all she's thinking about is putting on makeup. A lot of women lead with how they look, not with God on their mind. She thought she was going to impress him.

Bishop: what did she paint her face for? She wanted to entice the foolish men to be on her side with her beauty, but her beauty was superficial. That's what the scripture is showing us about a Jezebel spirit. Sisters, you don't have to overdo the makeup; that look is not feminine.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehu lifted up his face to the window and said, Who is on my side? Who? And two or three eunuchs looked out, and he said, Throw her down. They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands: exactly as God had spoken by his servant Elijah the Tishbite. This is the stuff they will never read in the Christian church.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: This is history of what happened, and there's also prophecy concerning what God says about the rebellious now. God is not with these emotions; God don't care if it's a woman. You put yourself in the wrong position against his instruction for the nation, God will address it.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Elisha sends one of the children of the prophets to Ramoth-gilead to anoint Jehu king over Israel, pour the oil on his head, and flee.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jehu is charged to smite the house of Ahab to avenge the blood of the prophets and of the servants of the Most High shed at the hand of Jezebel, whose work was to kill the prophets while weak Ahab let it continue.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: The word declares the whole house of Ahab shall perish, and the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel with none to bury her.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jehu's fellow captains ask why the mad fellow came, and when he tells them the prophet anointed him king, they hasten to put their garments under him and blow the trumpets, proclaiming Jehu king.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jehu conspires against Jehoram and charges that none escape the city to carry the news to Jezreel.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: He rides toward Jezreel where Jehoram lay wounded, and Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see him.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: A watchman spies Jehu's company, and two horsemen sent to ask if it is peace are each told to turn behind him and do not return, for the driving is furious like the driving of Jehu.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jehoram himself goes out and asks if it is peace, and Jehu answers that there can be no peace while the whoredoms and witchcrafts of his mother Jezebel are so many.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jehu draws his bow with full strength and smites Jehoram through the heart, then casts him into the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite according to the word of the Most High.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Ahaziah king of Judah flees but Jehu pursues and has him smitten in his chariot; he flees to Megiddo and dies there.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: His servants carry him to Jerusalem and bury him in the sepulchre of his fathers in the city of David.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jezebel paints her face and tires her head, returning to her seductive ways as Jehu enters the gate. Jehu calls out for who is on his side, and two or three eunuchs look out.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: At Jehu's word they throw her down, her blood is sprinkled on the wall and the horses, and he treads her under foot.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: When they go to bury her they find only the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands, fulfilling the word spoken by Elijah that dogs would eat the flesh of Jezebel and her carcass would be as dung upon the field.
